Engineer-led research for practical event technology.

Make the system

Event Tech Research exists to make modern production systems clearer, more resilient and easier to operate.

Our work sits between field engineering, R&D, education and careful documentation. We focus on clear signal paths, understandable control and monitoring that helps crews act.

We favour open standards, test in realistic conditions and document decisions so systems remain supportable after handover.
